sentences.text: 5. Learned A.P.P. for the State vehemently opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail and submits that petitioner is named in the F.I.R. with specific accusation that he forcibly established physical relation with informant and married in an Arya Samaj temple.
As per certificate, issued by Bihar School Examination Board, the date of birth of the victim is 12.07.2005 i.e. below 16 years at the time of alleged occurrence.
6. Considering the nature of accusation, the prayer for anticipatory bail of petitioner is rejected.
